name: Layoutless
author: kladafox
description: Automatic us/ru keyboard layout correction, Punto Switcher style, and the layout kept per window. Bar flag of the current layout: click switches it, right click opens auto-correction, the layout per window, the learned words and the ignored apps.

barWidget.description: Flag of the current layout, dimmed while auto-correction is paused. Left click switches the layout; right click opens the panel: pause auto-correction, the layout per window, the learned words and the ignored apps.
